Fixtures from the public Statens vegvesen camera "E18 Fiskevollbukta" (2026-11-01),
used under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD 2.0).

- e39_frame.jpg — "E39 Fjøsangerveien" frame with privacy-masked vehicles (tiled detection test)
